name: Ostercappeln (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ostercappeln (a black ring overlaid by a bend of red lozenges on white).
history: The arms, designed by Hans-Heinrich Reclam, were granted by the Regierungspräsident in Osnabrück in 1976 after the municipal reform of 1972.

features.role: Ostercappeln arms — ring and bend of lozenges
